english.note: Use this for routine miscellaneous duties, especially menial office or household tasks, without necessarily stressing physical exhaustion.

examples.english: I'm always tied up with drudgery and can't get to my real work.
examples.traditional: 我成日畀啲雜務纏住，做唔到正經工作。
